activity.title: Activity
activity.footnote: One square is 15 minutes ({timezone}). The approximate time counts quarters with any activity; it is not logged working time.
activity.load_error: Activity could not be loaded. Please try again later.

disabled.title: Activity is turned off
disabled.description: A project admin can turn it on in project settings → Features → Activity.
disabled.no_access: Only project admins and members can see the activity of this project.

settings.title: Activity
settings.description: A heatmap of when work happens in this project: one square per 15 minutes, a darker colour for more actions. Data are also available through the API.
settings.toggle_description: Shows Activity in the project navigation. Actions are recorded either way, so turning it on later shows the past too.
settings.kinds_description: Pick the actions that count as activity. The choice also applies to past actions.
settings.save_error: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.

issue.cycle_module: Added to a cycle or module

issue.created: A new work item in the project.
issue.state: Moving a work item to another state.
issue.property: Name, assignees, priority, labels, dates, estimate or parent.
issue.description: Changes to the description of a work item.
issue.comment: Adding, editing or deleting a comment.
issue.link: Adding or removing a link or an attachment.
issue.relation: Blocking, related, duplicate and other relations.
issue.cycle_module: Adding a work item to a cycle or module, or removing it.
issue.archive: Archiving, restoring or deleting a work item.
issue.intake: Work items coming in through Intake.

page.created: A new page in the project.
page.edited: Editing page content, at most once a minute per person and page.
page.renamed: Changing the title of a page.
page.archive: Archiving, restoring or deleting a page.

view.changed: Creating or editing a view of this project.

log.entry: Notes of what people and AI agents did, added on the Activity page or through the API. An entry fills every quarter of its time range.

log.text_placeholder: For example: fixed the redirect after sign-in and deployed it to staging.
log.save_error: Couldn't save the entry. Try again.
log.delete_confirm: The entry will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
log.delete_error: Couldn't delete the entry. Try again.
log.empty_title: No log entries in this range
log.empty_description: Log entries say what was done and when. Add them here, or let AI agents write them through the API or the plane-log script.
